mission: 在旧B4原输入放行差额中准确复用本任务刚接受的510300事后行动覆盖证据。仅2019-09-02至2026-06-30窗口两类现金分红和份额折算，读qualified-action-evidence.v2逐期间/原accepted source身份及原B4 normalized-actions引用，核同已知事件金额日期，证明现材料确支持哪些覆盖、是否有冲突。不得把现在取到年度原件当historicalavailable_at，不外推其他5产品/其他行动类型/实际到账，不生成价格或因子。新只读补注只纠正最新local-source readiness中的510300范围，原旧文件保留。
task_scope: bounded use-specific delta for one existing original B4 product
expected_outputs: Exact original product/period/category old-new evidence delta and R2 still blocked if others missing
stop_conditions: No new source, price/true factor or account computation
No old contract/result edits or shared-state writes
user_authority: 2026-10-11 direct user: continue remaining eight goals; parallelize independent subagents for efficiency.
referenced_evidence_read_policy: Only the directly referenced existing reports/manifests/contracts may be read. No writes outside exact output; do not scan whole library.
